title: Law of large numbers for roots of finite free multiplicative convolution powers
author: Fujie, Katsunori, Ueda, Yuki
work: Law of Large Numbers for Roots of Finite Free Multiplicative Convolution of Polynomials
difficulty_reason: 266-309由卷积幂的系数关系出发，以有序根的前i项乘积及组合项数，双侧夹住第i根与相邻对称多项式比；取n次根令组合常数消失。实质是从整体系数恢复逐根极限的夹逼设计，不是直接系数代入；保留H2，两个计算引理不另计。

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the Theorem: derives from the convolution identity eq:symm_root that the ratio of consecutive normalized elementary symmetric functions of the n-th root multiset equals the n-th power of the same ratio for Lambda; handles i=1 by squeezing the average of the roots between the first root and the first root alone, giving the limit tilde-e_1; for 2 <= i <= d-k squeezes lambda_i^(n) between constant multiples of the ratio e_i/e_{i-1} of the raw elementary symmetric functions by bounding each partial sum by the top products and their count, substitutes the n-th power identity eq:Lambda_S, takes n-th roots, and reads the limit (source lines 266-309)
